description: Send transactional email and manage domains, templates, webhooks and suppressions with Groundmail.

tool_signatures.name: add_suppression
tool_signatures.description: Add an address to the suppression list.

tool_signatures.name: apply_domain_dns
tool_signatures.description: Apply Groundmail DNS records for a domain through Cloudflare, Vercel or GoDaddy, using the provider account connected in the dashboard. If none is connected, ask the user to connect it at https://app.groundmail.dev/integrations (never ask for the provider token in chat), or have them publish the records from create_domain by hand.

tool_signatures.name: create_domain
tool_signatures.description: Add a sending domain. DNS must still be applied and verified before production sends.

tool_signatures.name: create_template
tool_signatures.description: Create a draft email template (html or blocks format).

tool_signatures.name: create_tenant
tool_signatures.description: Create a tenant for one of your customers. Then send with tenant set to its external id, and give it its own domains with create_domain (tenant).

tool_signatures.name: create_webhook
tool_signatures.description: Create a webhook endpoint. Returns the endpoint plus a signing secret (shown once).

tool_signatures.name: delete_webhook
tool_signatures.description: Delete a webhook endpoint by id.

tool_signatures.name: enable_dmarc_monitoring
tool_signatures.description: Turn on free DMARC monitoring for a sending domain. Returns the report address and the exact DMARC record to publish (the current record with the address added to rua=, keeping the policy and other report addresses). Pass apply to update the record through a DNS provider connected in the dashboard. Reports start arriving within 24 to 48 hours.

tool_signatures.name: get_deliverability
tool_signatures.description: Fetch best-effort deliverability metrics for recent sends (7d or 30d window).

tool_signatures.name: get_dmarc_report
tool_signatures.description: DMARC monitoring for a sending domain: who sends mail as it (grouped by provider, with unknown senders flagged as possible spoofing), SPF/DKIM/DMARC pass rates over the last 30 days, and whether it is safe to move the DMARC policy to quarantine. If monitoring is off, shows the current DMARC record; turn it on with enable_dmarc_monitoring.

tool_signatures.name: get_email
tool_signatures.description: Get a single email by public id (msg_…).

tool_signatures.name: get_import_report
tool_signatures.description: Beta. The stored report of an import from SendGrid, Postmark or Mailgun: what was imported, skipped and failed, the DNS changes per domain, what still needs doing, the code change and a prompt for it. Pass the import id, or omit it for the latest import. Previews are not stored.

tool_signatures.name: get_template
tool_signatures.description: Get a template by id or alias.

tool_signatures.name: get_tenant
tool_signatures.description: Get one tenant, including whether it is paused and why.

tool_signatures.name: get_tenant_stats
tool_signatures.description: A tenant

tool_signatures.name: get_test_email
tool_signatures.description: Get one caught test email with its text and HTML bodies, headers, source, code and links.

tool_signatures.name: get_test_inbox_address
tool_signatures.description: Get a fresh unique address on the team

tool_signatures.name: import_from_provider
tool_signatures.description: Beta. Import templates, suppressions (bounces, complaints, unsubscribes), sending domains and webhooks from SendGrid, Postmark or Mailgun into Groundmail. Ask the user for their provider API key; it is used for this import only and never stored, so do not write it to a file. Run with dry_run first to show the user what will be imported. Imported webhooks start disabled; templates that use logic Groundmail does not convert are imported as drafts. The result includes what needs attention, the code change, and a prompt for making it.

tool_signatures.name: list_category_opt_outs
tool_signatures.description: List category opt-outs: addresses that used a one-click unsubscribe to leave product or newsletter email. Sends in that category to them are refused until the opt-out is removed.

tool_signatures.name: list_domains
tool_signatures.description: List sending domains for this account.

tool_signatures.name: list_emails
tool_signatures.description: List recent emails sent from this account. Test emails (test keys, simulator addresses) have test: true.

tool_signatures.name: list_suppressions
tool_signatures.description: List suppressed recipient addresses.

tool_signatures.name: list_templates
tool_signatures.description: List email templates.

tool_signatures.name: list_tenants
tool_signatures.description: List tenants: one per customer you send email for, each with its own domains, suppression list, stats, pause switch and daily limit. Tenants are included on pay as you go and the Dedicated plan.

tool_signatures.name: list_test_emails
tool_signatures.description: List emails caught in the test inbox (and emails sent with a gm_test_ key), newest first, with the extracted one-time code and links. Kept 14 days.

tool_signatures.name: list_webhooks
tool_signatures.description: List webhook endpoints for this account.

tool_signatures.name: pause_tenant
tool_signatures.description: Pause a tenant: its new sends are refused until it is resumed. The rest of the account keeps sending. Confirm with the user first.

tool_signatures.name: publish_template
tool_signatures.description: Publish a template, snapshotting an immutable version for sends.

tool_signatures.name: remove_category_opt_out
tool_signatures.description: Remove a category opt-out by id or email address so the address receives that category again. Use only when the reader has asked to re-subscribe.

tool_signatures.name: remove_suppression
tool_signatures.description: Remove a suppression by id or email address.

tool_signatures.name: resume_tenant
tool_signatures.description: Resume a paused tenant so it can send again. A tenant Groundmail paused (pause_source automated or admin) cannot be resumed this way; the user should fix the cause and contact support.

tool_signatures.name: send_email
tool_signatures.description: Send a transactional email via Groundmail. Provide subject + html/text, or a published template_id / template_alias with optional variables. To test without delivering anything, send to a simulator address: delivered@, bounce@, block@, complaint@, suppressed@ or delayed@simulator.groundmail.dev (plus addressing like bounce+test1@ works); the result has test: true and webhooks fire as for real mail.

tool_signatures.name: send_test_webhook_event
tool_signatures.description: Simulate a webhook event (POST /emails/test) for CI or local webhook testing. Optionally deliver to subscribed endpoints.

tool_signatures.name: update_tenant
tool_signatures.description: Change a tenant

tool_signatures.name: validate_email
tool_signatures.description: Check one email address with Groundmail validation before accepting it (for example at signup): verdict valid | risky | invalid, reasons, a typo suggestion, and disposable / role flags. Free; sends nothing.

tool_signatures.name: verify_domain
tool_signatures.description: Verify DNS for a sending domain after records are applied.

tool_signatures.name: wait_for_test_email
tool_signatures.description: Wait for an email to a test inbox address and return it, with the one-time code and links extracted. An email that already arrived is returned at once. Waits up to timeout seconds (default 30, at most 60); on timeout, check that the app sent to the exact address and call again.
